compute_crs.name: Mars Gale-centred Azimuthal Equidistant (lat_0=-5.4, lon_0=137.8, R=3396190 m)

elevation_sampling.note: The elevation profile is thinned along the path; the waypoint indices used are reported so the thinning is never hidden.

calculated.note: The ordering/temporal dimension is resolved here: the trajectory is sorted along the detected ordering column (sclk = monotonic spacecraft clock).

assumptions: The source's declared CRS is trusted as a Mars planetocentric lon/lat (east-positive) frame; no Earth CRS is ever substituted.
Waypoints are ordered along the detected ordering column (found: 'sclk'); the rover-trajectory layer carries the pipeline's temporal concept.
Elevation is sampled from the locally supplied MSL PLACES base DEM where it covers a station, and backfilled from the remote Layer-2 Gale DEM elsewhere; points no DEM covers are reported null.
limitations: Path length is the sum of great-circle-free straight segments in the AEQD compute CRS.
The PLACES table is an interpolated localization product: positions between drives are interpolation, not measurements.
